title: bojjhaṅgā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Venerable sir, it is said,
‘Factors of enlightenment, factors of enlightenment.’
In what sense are they called factors of enlightenment?”
“‘They lead to enlightenment,’ bhikkhu,
therefore they are called ‘factors of enlightenment.’”
